plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Economics (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] MATH 148 , MATH 152 , or MATH 172 will be accepted in lieu of MATH 140 .
[grid1 fn3] MATH 147 , MATH 151 , or MATH 171 will be accepted in lieu of MATH 142 .
[grid1 fn4] ECON 323 is a pre-requisite for most ECON electives.
[grid1 fn5] Select any 100-499 course not used elsewhere. ECON 100-499 and ECMT 100-499 may not be used to fulfill this requirement.
[grid1 fn6] Select from ECMT 475 ; ECON 301-499.
[grid1 fn7] Select from ACCT 210 ; FINC 409 ; FINP 235 , FINP 335 , FINP 435 , FINP 436 , FINP 437 , FINP 438 ; GEOG 304 ; INTA 221 , INTA 231 ; ISTM 209 ; PBSI 251 ; PHIL 240 , PHIL 451 , PHIL 452 ; POLS 233 , POLS 340/PSAA 340 , POLS 424 , POLS 475 ; PSAA 364 , PSAA 440 ; RWFM 375 ; SOCI 320 ; URPN 340 , URPN 361 , URPN 370 .
